how_to_apply: Visit the official recruitment portal at recruitment.cftri.res.in.
Select Recruitment for the post of Technician (1) under Advertisement No. Rec.02/2026.
Read the application instructions and eligibility conditions carefully.
Complete online registration and access the application form.
Enter the required personal, educational, category and experience details.
Select the eligible trade and post code.
Upload the prescribed photograph, signature, educational certificates and supporting documents.
Review the application using the Preview and Submit section.
Complete the final submission and record the generated Application Number.
If the application fee is applicable, pay Rs. 500 through SBI Collect.
Enter the payment details and upload the payment receipt to the application portal.
Download and print the completed application before 18 November 2026 at 11:59 PM.
Sign the printed application, attach a recent colour photograph and self-attested supporting documents.
Send the application by Speed Post or Registered Post so that it reaches CSIR-CFTRI by 26 November 2026.
Multiple Post Codes: Eligible candidates may apply for more than one post code, but must submit a separate complete application, applicable fee and supporting documents for each post code.

content_sections.heading: CSIR CFTRI Technician Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: CSIR-CFTRI has announced 28 Technician (1) vacancies across 13 trades. Horizontal Reservation: Of the 28 posts, two are reserved for eligible Ex-servicemen and two for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities. These are included within the total vacancies. The PwBD reservations are identified under Electronics Mechanic (category c) and COPA (category b).

rows.trade: Information and Communication Technology System Maintenance

content_sections.heading: CSIR CFTRI Technician Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must have passed SSC/10th Standard or an equivalent examination with Science subjects and secured at least 55% marks . In addition, they must satisfy one of the following trade-specific qualification routes. Important: ITI is not mandatory if the applicant qualifies through one of the other expressly permitted routes. The trade named in the certificate, apprenticeship training or work experience must correspond to the selected Technician post.

rows.requirement: 10th with Science subjects and minimum 55% marks, plus ITI Certificate or National/State Trade Certificate in the relevant trade
10th with Science subjects and minimum 55% marks, plus two years of full-time apprenticeship training from a recognized institution in the relevant trade

10th with Science subjects and minimum 55% marks, plus three years of relevant work experience in a Ministry, Department, Government Organization, PSU or Autonomous Body under the Central/State/UT Government as prescribed

rows.required_trade_specialization: Information and Communication Technology System Maintenance

content_sections.heading: CSIR CFTRI Technician Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Technician (1) posts carry Pay Level 2 under the applicable CSIR pay structure. The approximate monthly emoluments are calculated at the minimum of the pay scale, including admissible HRA at Mysuru headquarters. Other benefits may include DA, transport allowance, medical reimbursement, Leave Travel Concession, Children's Education Allowance and pension benefits under applicable rules.

content_sections.heading: CSIR CFTRI Technician Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The Rs. 500 application fee is non-refundable and payable through SBI Collect. Candidates claiming fee exemption must upload the relevant supporting documents. Fee Payment Requirement: Candidates required to pay the fee must enter the transaction details and upload the SBI Collect e-receipt on the recruitment portal by 18 November 2026 at 11:59 PM. Payment alone does not complete the application process.

content_sections.heading: CSIR CFTRI Technician Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection involves screening of applications, a qualifying Trade Test and a competitive Written Examination. Screening of applications and eligibility documents. Trade Test in the relevant trade, qualifying in nature. Competitive Written Examination comprising Paper I, Paper II and Paper III. Preparation of final merit based on Paper II and Paper III marks, subject to qualifying requirements. Verification of eligibility and other appointment formalities. Merit Rule: Paper I is qualifying in nature. Paper II and Paper III will be evaluated only for candidates securing the prescribed Paper I threshold. Final merit is based on the combined marks in Paper II and Paper III, not Paper I.

content_sections.heading: CSIR CFTRI Technician Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The written examination consists of 150 objective-type questions over 2 hours and 30 minutes . It may be conducted through OMR or computer-based mode. Paper I: 2 marks for every correct answer; no negative marking. Paper II: 3 marks for every correct answer; 1 mark deducted for every incorrect answer. Paper III: 3 marks for every correct answer; 1 mark deducted for every incorrect answer. Medium: English and Hindi, except questions relating to the English language. Examination Standard: SSC + ITI / 12th Standard. The notification identifies the examination subjects but does not provide a detailed topic-by-topic syllabus for each of the 13 trades.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSIR CFTRI Technician Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Multiple Post Codes: Eligible candidates may apply for more than one post code, but must submit a separate complete application, applicable fee and supporting documents for each post code.

content_sections.heading: CSIR CFTRI Technician Hard Copy Submission Address
content_sections.text: Send the signed application printout and required documents to: The application must be sent through Speed Post or Registered Post only . Postal delays will not be accepted as grounds for considering a late application.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for CSIR CFTRI Technician Recruitment
content_sections.text: Signed printout of the completed online application Recent passport-size colour photograph 10th/SSC certificate and marksheet ITI or National/State Trade Certificate, if applying through the trade-certificate route Relevant apprenticeship certificate or work-experience certificate, if applicable Proof of date of birth SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/EWS certificate, where applicable PwBD or Ex-servicemen supporting certificates, where applicable Employer's No Objection Certificate for eligible serving employees, where required Copy of SBI Collect payment receipt, if applicable Other prescribed supporting documents and certificates All required copies must be self-attested and attached to the hard-copy application. Candidates should also upload clear scans through the online portal.

content_sections.heading: CSIR CFTRI Technician Job Location 2026
content_sections.text: Selected candidates may be posted at CSIR-CFTRI headquarters in Mysuru or at its resource centres in Hyderabad, Mumbai and Lucknow. They may also be transferred to other CSIR laboratories and institutes anywhere in India as required.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in CSIR CFTRI Technician Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: CSIR-CFTRI has announced 28 Technician (1) vacancies across 13 trades.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application, complete applicable fee payment and download the form is 18 November 2026 at 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q3. Is sending the hard copy mandatory?
faq.answer: Yes. The signed application and required supporting documents must reach CSIR-CFTRI by 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. Can 10th Pass candidates apply without ITI?
faq.answer: Yes, provided they have passed 10th with Science subjects and at least 55% marks and meet the alternative qualification route of two years of prescribed apprenticeship training or three years of relevant qualifying work experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for CSIR CFTRI Technician?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 28 years as of 18 November 2026, with applicable category-based relaxations.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for CSIR CFTRI Technician?
faq.answer: The posts carry Pay Level 2 (Rs. 19,900–63,200), with approximate monthly emoluments of Rs. 37,260 at Mysuru headquarters.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500 for applicable categories. SC, ST, PwBD, women and Ex-servicemen candidates are exempt, subject to the prescribed conditions.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process includes application screening, a qualifying Trade Test and a competitive Written Examination. Final merit is based on Paper II and Paper III marks.

faq.question: Q9. How many questions are in the Technician written examination?
faq.answer: The examination has 150 objective questions carrying a maximum of 400 marks over 150 minutes.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates apply for more than one trade?
faq.answer: Yes, if eligible. Candidates must submit separate complete applications and applicable fees for each post code.
